prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production transparent 2D platformer enemy art: a cute BURROWING MOLE for a pink sandstone canyon full of round holes at peach sunset. Compact warm taupe mole with pink nose, small amber miner goggles pushed above its brow, cream belly, lavender neckerchief, broad rounded digging paws with ivory claws, tiny sturdy feet, dusty rosy cheeks. An eager mischievous excavator, not scary. Whole body RIGHT-FACING three-quarter side profile, storybook gouache/cartoon with soft texture and rich warm plum-brown outlines. EXACTLY EIGHT distinct complete poses of this same character, in a FOUR columns x TWO rows grid. Each character should occupy only SIXTY-FIVE percent of its cell, with wide transparent gutters on EVERY side; no limb or pose may touch a cell edge or image edge. Same body scale. Reading order: 1 idle, 2 blink idle, 3 walking A, 4 walking B, 5 warning plants paws on the ground and prepares to dig, 6 attack strongly scoops ground forward with both paws without extra detached dirt or projectiles, 7 recovery wiping brow with paw, 8 defeated sitting with spiral eyes and claws harmlessly folded. Do not hide body underground, all bodies and feet visible. Actual transparent alpha background, no ground, no scenery, no shadows outside bodies, no glow, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no checkerboard. Make crisp game-ready silhouettes with generous safe margins.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D platformer enemy sprite sheet. Original cute HOLLOW RING-STONE GOLEM for a peach sunset canyon of pink sandstone arches and round holes. A small round peach-sandstone donut-shaped golem with a clearly open circular hole through its torso, tiny bright dark-plum eyes on the upper stone rim, a cheeky smiling small mouth on the lower rim, lilac stone mitten arms, short ochre stone feet, subtle carved concentric rings. Pink, peach, cream and lilac, warm storybook gouache shading and crisp plum-brown outlines. A playful stone-ring bowler personality, round compact silhouette, not scary. Whole body RIGHT facing three-quarter profile. EXACTLY EIGHT poses of SAME character in uniform FOUR columns by TWO rows grid. Characters occupy only SIXTY-FIVE percent of each cell; VERY LARGE transparent gutters, whole bodies safely inside every cell and image edge, stable body scale. Reading order: 1 idle, 2 idle blink, 3 walking stride A, 4 walking stride B, 5 warning leans back with one ring-shaped stone hand drawn behind body to prepare rolling, 6 attack rolling/tossing its attached small ring hand forward like bowling but no detached projectile, 7 recovery catches the same hand near belly smiling tiredly, 8 defeated low seated with spiral eyes, whole donut body intact. Keep center hole visibly empty in every pose. No extra props, no floating objects, no background, no ground, no external shadows, no glow, no labels, no lettering, no grid borders, no checkerboard. Actual clean transparent PNG, usable animation artwork.
